odd_divisor_proof: For odd D<=MASK, g(D-1)=D-1 and g(D)=D XOR1=D-1. D=1 is also noninjective. Permutation P must visit both values, contradicting permutation target.
leading_bit_proof: For D>=2 and2^j<=P<2^(j+1), floor(P/D)<2^j, so Y=P XOR floor(P/D) has the same leading1. Y<128 therefore implies P<128. D>=128 gives q=0 on every such P and has a single shared profile.
polynomial_scope: Every one-MAD prefix is contained in the21-coefficient quadratic span in the five exact base fields. A failed congruence system excludes all root-only MAD constants. bit_fits separately covers every first XOR/AND/OR and arbitrary prepared masks.
ceil_rem_xor_prefix: For D>=2, P=0 and1 both give P XOR ceil(P/D)=0 and P XOR(P%D)=0; permutation P makes the target noninjective. D=1 floor/ceil gives0 and REM gives the T-only prefix.

bitop_only_prefix_reduction.proof: Every listed f(P,q) has f(0,0)=0 and q is a conservative function of P. Runtime XOR prefixes are nonzero at the target-zero witness because its nine initial values differ. Runtime OR prefixes are nonzero there. An AND prefix containing a permutation initial I is<=I; if both P and I are permutations, sums force P=I, which is nonzero there. The AND of the only two nonpermutation initials cannot reach MASK. Prepared AND/OR masks require MASK/0 for a permutation prefix and again give an initial word. Prepared XOR retains only the seven permutation initials, with its key pinned at target0.

P_plus_scalar_times_q.proof: G must be odd by b16 parity. At P=1, q is0 or1. q=0 would give Y=1; q=1 pins G=Y-1, which is even.

P_square_plus_q.proof: At P=1, q<=1, so P^2+q is1 or2, below the target.

bitop_P_q.proof: At P=1, q<=1, so any binary bitop of P/q is at most1.
